concept.title: Air conditioning (A/C) automatic drying
concept.shortdesc: The A/C automatic drying feature dries the moisture in the A/C and reduces A/C odor. The blower motor automatically operates after the vehicle has been turned off for 30 minutes.

keywords.indexterm: automatic climate control system air conditioning (A/C) automatic drying

section.title: Turning A/C automatic drying on or off
section.p: You can turn the A/C automatic drying feature on and off by selecting SetingsClimateClimate FeaturesA/C Automatic Drying on the infotainment system screen.
When the A/C automatic drying feature is activated, the air conditioner sets the fan speed to the third level, selects the outside (fresh) air position, and directs the airflow to the floor.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after a software update. For more details, refer to the user’s manual in the infotainment system or the quick reference guide.

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: The A/C automatic drying feature operates under the following conditions:

li.p: The vehicle is turned off after operating the air conditioner for a certain period
The outside temperature is above a certain level

section.title: Non-operating conditions
section.p: The A/C automatic drying feature stops operating under the following conditions:

li.p: The A/C automatic drying feature has operated for 10 minutes
The the vehicle is in ACC position or ON position
The climate control system is operated remotely
The A/C automatic drying feature reduces A/C odors but may not remove all odors.
To prevent 12V battery discharge, the A/C automatic drying feature does not operate if the remaining 12V battery level is insufficient.
